doc.title: Billy Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

title: Basie as bandleader
summary: Basie was easy to work for; he never worked with Ellington.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: What kind of band leader was Basie? Was he easy to work for?
Yeah. He was easy to work for.
Him and Ellington seemed to have very different styles of leading a group from what I’ve heard.
I wouldn’t know. I never worked with the Duke’s band.
